BL-836 — A waiting clarification is readable and answerable over the bridge, through the same delivery a Telegram tap already uses
What it solves: ## Verified against `main` before speccing (2026-08-06)
Approval context: Two decisions of mine are worth a look before a coder starts, both answering open questions the intake explicitly left to the specifier.
(1) When more than one role is waiting, v1 offers the LONGEST-WAITING one, not a queue. The intake asked "if two roles ask, v1 show one (which?) or a short queue"…
BL-836 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-836" (or "reject BL-836 <reason>") to act.
